# Patify

> AI-powered lost pet finder and adoption platform connecting missing animals with their owners across Turkey.

Patify is Turkey's leading digital platform for lost pet reunification and animal adoption, leveraging AI image recognition and location-based matching to help reunite missing pets with their families. The platform serves as a community hub for pet owners, adopters, and animal lovers across major Turkish cities including Istanbul, Izmir, and Mersin.

## Key Topics

- Lost pet finder
- Pet adoption
- AI image recognition
- Location-based matching
- Pet reunification
- Missing animals database
- Turkey pet community
- Mobile app (iOS/Android)
- Stray pet rehoming
- Pet listings
- Interactive pet map
- Pet care guides
- KVKK data protection
- Marmara region
- Pet identification

## Lost Pet Services

- [Lost Pets](https://patifyapp.com/pets): Browse lost pet listings across Turkey with 106+ missing animals
- [Pet Map](https://patifyapp.com/pet-map): Interactive map showing nearby pets and street animals
- [Home](https://patifyapp.com): Patify homepage: AI-powered lost pet finder and adoption platform for Turkey

## Pet Adoption & Rehoming

- [Pet Adoption](https://patifyapp.com/straypets): Pet adoption platform: dogs, cats and animals ready for rehoming

## Pet Education & Resources

- [Pet Care Guides](https://patifyapp.com/content): Pet care guides, articles and videos for dogs, cats and birds
